purpose: Evidence provenance and availability registry for the control-flow guide; not a hardware certification.

provenance_kinds.E-STATIC: Recovered source, executable instructions, command tables, or resources.
provenance_kinds.E-EMULATED: Selected original x86 functions in Unicorn with CVI/CRT interception.
provenance_kinds.E-SYNTHETIC: Simulator, recorded-value replay, offline tests, or localhost transport.
provenance_kinds.E-NATIVE-NO-DEVICE: Actual NI runtime calls or GUI with no physical device connection.
provenance_kinds.E-PHYSICAL-READONLY: Actual device query observations with no actuator writes.
provenance_kinds.E-PHYSICAL-WRAPPED: Actual device observations through a bounded diagnostic wrapper.
provenance_kinds.E-MANUAL: Identified manufacturer operating manual; applicability limited to document model and revision.
provenance_kinds.E-PUBLICATION-STANDARD: Identified document-formatting authority; not device-operation evidence.
provenance_kinds.E-UNKNOWN: Required record or authoritative specification absent.
